groups.saying_opens: أن ابن عمر رضى الله عنهما كان يكري
أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى عن

notes: Two sayings with their own isnads (owner ruling 6): Ibn Umar's practice is relayed by Nafi' (Ibn Umar stays out as a described act), and the Prophet's prohibition is relayed through Rafi' b. Khadij
In the encounter («فذهب ابن عمر إلى رافع ... فسأله فقال») Rafi' speaks, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5); «قد علمت أنا كنا نكري» is Ibn Umar's remark without a chain
